name: Kidney growth restraint and mesenchymal cell survival
rationale: All members limit kidney/metanephros growth or block developmental mesenchymal apoptosis; the anti-apoptotic mesenchymal arm separates it from confusables focused on proliferation, ureteric/nephric duct formation or metanephric differentiation.

name: MET receptor tyrosine kinase signaling
rationale: Every member is a MET (HGF receptor) activation, effector, recycling or inhibition event, unlike the integrin/adhesion and PTK6/ALK kinase confusables.

name: Lymphocyte antigen receptor signaling, costimulation and co-inhibition
rationale: Members cover proximal TCR and BCR signaling plus CD28 costimulation and CTLA4/BTLA/CD22 inhibitory tuning, whereas confusables are T cell-only activation/differentiation or B cell proliferation sets.

name: Presynaptic release modulation and AMPA/kainate receptor signaling
rationale: Members regulate presynaptic glutamate/GABA release, calcium and potential plus AMPA/kainate receptor activation and clustering, distinguishing it from the vesicle release cycle, NMDA/LTP and inhibitory synapse assembly confusables.

qualifier: intracellular destruction complex to TCF/LEF targets
name: Intracellular canonical Wnt/beta-catenin signaling to TCF/LEF targets
rationale: Members span DVL activation, destruction complex (AXIN/APC) and beta-catenin:TCF/LEF transcriptional control, while confusables center on ligand secretion, FZD/LRP receptor-level regulation and non-canonical Wnt.

name: Lymphocyte cytokine suppression with Treg differentiation restraint
rationale: Members suppress IL-2, IL-21, IL-6 and TNF-superfamily production while limiting Treg differentiation and favoring activated T cell proliferation, unlike innate IL-1/TLR suppression or Treg-promoting T cell inhibition confusables.

qualifier: kidney, lung and glandular branching organs
name: Kidney, lung and glandular epithelial organ development
rationale: Members are epithelial-mesenchymal organogenesis of kidney, lung, mammary, prostate, salivary, pancreatic and reproductive-tract epithelia, distinguishing it from heart, gonad/endocrine, HOX axial patterning and podocyte confusables.

name: Chondrocyte differentiation, proliferation and hypertrophy
rationale: All members concern chondroblast/chondrocyte condensation, differentiation, proliferation and hypertrophy, whereas confusables are osteoblast and ossification sets.
Members mix magnesium transport/homeostasis, inositol transport/metabolism and generic protein tetramerization/hexamerization with no shared biological process.

name: Intramembranous bone formation and tendon development
rationale: Members are direct ossification, cranial suture, trabecula and osteoblast development plus tendon development, distinguished from chondrocyte and osteoblast-proliferation/collagen-regulation confusables.

name: Cation-chloride cotransporters and sodium/proton exchangers
rationale: Members center on SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporters, SLC9 Na+/H+ exchangers and their disease variants plus potassium and vesicle acidification transport, unlike the SLC26/bicarbonate anion-exchange and osmotic/renal sodium confusables.

name: Mitotic centrosome maturation and separation at G2/M
rationale: Members involve AURKA, PLK1 and NEK kinase control of centrosome protein recruitment, separation and spindle assembly at mitotic entry, unlike checkpoint/cytokinesis and spindle-orientation confusables.

name: Nuclear pore complex turnover and inositol phosphate transport
rationale: Members are NPC assembly, disassembly, reformation and TPR plus inositol phosphate shuttling through the pore, distinguishing it from protein/RNA nucleocytoplasmic transport and nuclear envelope reformation confusables.

name: Regulation of mitochondrial respiration and oxidative phosphorylation
rationale: All members regulate electron transport, cellular respiration, ATP synthesis or associated ROS output, while confusables concern oxidative-stress and hypoxia-induced cell death.

name: Oocyte meiotic maturation and antral follicle growth
rationale: Members cover oocyte meiotic maturation and antral ovarian follicle growth, distinguished from germ cell/testis and ovulation/luteinization confusables.

name: Sister chromatid cohesion, condensation and mitotic spindle segregation
rationale: Members span cohesin establishment and resolution, chromosome condensation, CENP-A deposition, spindle/checkpoint and centrosome control, unlike nuclear envelope/abscission and contractile ring confusables.

name: T cell response suppression with regulatory T cell promotion
rationale: Members dampen CD4/CD8 T cell activation, proliferation, Th1/Th17 and IFN output while promoting Treg differentiation, distinguishing it from NK, dendritic cell tolerance and Treg-restraining confusables.

name: Sarcomere myofilament assembly and muscle stretch sensing
rationale: Members are thin/thick filament and myofibril assembly plus stretch detection, unlike costamere/ILK, myogenesis and heart morphogenesis confusables.

name: Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization in oxidative-stress apoptosis
rationale: Members regulate intrinsic apoptosis to hydrogen peroxide, hypoxia and oxygen-glucose deprivation via MOMP, cytochrome c release, BAD and membrane potential, which confusables lack.

name: SLIT-ROBO signaling in commissural axon midline guidance
rationale: Members are ROBO receptor signaling to RHO GTPases and ABL plus commissural midline choice, distinguishing it from netrin/ephrin/L1 and retinal or dopaminergic axon guidance confusables.

name: Nuclear RNA surveillance and decay
rationale: All members degrade snRNAs, cryptic unstable transcripts and aberrant mRNAs in the nucleus, unlike cytoplasmic mRNA decay, mRNA export and rRNA processing confusables.

name: Metanephric mesenchyme survival and mesenchymal-to-epithelial differentiation
rationale: Members combine metanephric mesenchyme maintenance, survival and mesenchymal-to-epithelial tubule differentiation with kidney growth restraint, distinguishing it from nephric duct/ureteric bud and nephron-segment confusables.

name: DNA double-strand break signaling and end-joining repair
rationale: Members cover DSB sensing, ATM signaling, BRCA1/2 defects, classical and alternative NHEJ and repair-pathway choice, unlike resection/Fanconi/PARP and telomere/replication-stress confusables.

core: Viral host cell entry and life cycle
name: Dengue and RSV host entry and viral life cycle
rationale: Members promote viral attachment, entry, transport and assembly with dengue and RSV entry modules, distinguishing it from influenza/HIV entry, host restriction and viral protein maturation confusables.

name: Mitotic nuclear envelope breakdown and ESCRT-III resealing
rationale: Members cover lamina depolymerization, nuclear membrane disassembly and reassembly and ESCRT-III sealing and abscission, unlike nuclear pore complex and cytokinesis ring confusables.
